# Changes in 0.2.0

This is an update to the final `MLAI-website-source.zip` delivery, retaining its route set and design.

## Added

Contextual section-aware search and safe Unicode highlighting; document reading tools/progress/mobile contents; canonical Markdown article export and print styles; evidence text/query filters; explicit system-theme preference; brief length counters and document-memory continuity; no-JavaScript brief guards; scoped HTTP method/header tests; framework/lockfile preflight; required MDX type declaration; nineteen regression tests and twenty-two improvement browser groups.

## Changed

Split enhancement code by responsibility with abortable idempotent lifetimes. Preserve article DOM for anchor-only navigation. Synchronise visible/accessible search and tab selection. Escape user-entered HTML in Markdown brief exports. Make local review server read-only with explicit route/file boundaries and policy headers. Extend CI to run both browser suites and keep the actual framework gate separate.

## Preserved

Original homepage copy and composition; white/graphite/violet visual identity; four projects; eight docs pages; 17 content routes plus 404; canonical content and source notes; no accounts, analytics, AI calls, remote brief submissions or production integration.

## Not a release claim

The portable review is tested. The Next.js/Fumadocs candidate still lacks an installed dependency graph, reviewed lockfile, compiled framework output and hydration evidence. No public deployment or existing repository change was made.
